mechanism.claim: A large completed New York-session rise in USDCAD relative to USDAUD isolates CAD and oil-linked stress from broad US-dollar movement; the inverse isolates relative commodity-risk relief. In a high-variation BTC regime, relative CAD stress maps short BTC and relief maps long for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of USDCAD session return minus USDAUD session return
mechanism.why_distinct: Dollar-factor and dollar-breadth candidates aggregate canonical USD direction across six pairs. ACUCR uses AUD/JPY sign concordance in Asia. CCRSR differences two same-quote commodity currencies, cancelling common USD direction and retaining a continuous CAD-versus-AUD relative shock; it is neither a pair subset breadth nor a prior control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: pre-decision BTC 24-hour realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one weekday 21:05 UTC relative commodity-FX clock is absent from Gross9

features.fx_session: bars_polygon USDCAD and USDAUD 1m rows with 13:00<=UTC time<21:00 on one UTC weekday
features.session_valid: each pair has at least 450 distinct minutes, first<=13:05, last>=20:55, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.relative_stress: USDCAD return minus USDAUD return, strict nonzero
features.absolute_stress_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 252 prior valid weekday sessions, minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed BTC hourly returns over 24 hours ending at 21:00)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 252 prior valid weekday decisions, minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no pair, session, spread, rank, history, threshold, variation, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
